about: Seed list for the provisioning asset library (#107). Metadata only: no asset files are stored in git. `library.py seed` builds a library from this list, downloading each `download` and checking its sha256. Built-in entries are already on the headset and are never shipped.

entries.name: textPrefab
entries.description: 3D text label. Its text, font size and color come from a TextMeshProComponent on the object.
entries.notes: Moon-lab built-in. Description written from its use in the moon lab; check against the Unity prefab.

entries.name: demoPrefab
entries.description: System root object of a demo module, created automatically for every module. Not a visible model; never reused for a scene object.
entries.notes: Moon-lab built-in (json_lab fills it in on every DemoModule).

entries.name: SunPrefab
entries.description: The Sun: a sphere showing the Sun, used at scale 5 in the moon lab.
entries.notes: Moon-lab built-in. Description written from its use in the moon lab; check against the Unity prefab (whether it glows or lights the scene).

entries.name: moveableSphere
entries.description: Sphere that students can grab and move. Takes a texture or a color (the Earth, the Moon and a basketball in the moon lab).
entries.notes: Moon-lab built-in. Description written from its use in the moon lab; check against the Unity prefab.

entries.name: clickableSphere
entries.description: Sphere that responds when clicked or selected. Takes a texture or a color (the Earth and the Moon in the moon lab).
entries.notes: Moon-lab built-in. Description written from its use in the moon lab; check against the Unity prefab.

entries.name: tinySphere
entries.description: Small sphere used as a marker or point. Takes a color (red marker balls in the moon lab).
entries.notes: Moon-lab built-in. Description written from its use in the moon lab; check against the Unity prefab.

entries.name: robotIdle
entries.description: Robot character standing idle, used as a guide or observer figure.
entries.notes: Moon-lab built-in. Description written from its name and use in the moon lab; check against the Unity prefab.

entries.name: balldimpled
entries.description: Dimpled ball surface, used on the basketball in the moon lab.

entries.name: 2k_earth_daymap
entries.description: Earth as seen in daylight: true-color land, oceans and ice, no clouds. Equirectangular (2:1), wraps a sphere.
entries.notes: Moon-lab built-in texture; the file is kept so it can be previewed, checked and shipped if the headset needs it in the zip (#105).

provenance.author: Solar System Scope (INOVE)
provenance.title: Earth Day Map (2k)
provenance.notes: Based on NASA elevation and imagery data.
